next_step: Closed - handoff docs + final notes to AE; archive opportunity
notes:
Summary: Closed — lost to hyperscaler managed endpoints (AWS Bedrock / SageMaker) and procurement discounts. Team liked Redwood performance and billing transparency but final decision favored native AWS endpoints for integration with existing S3/IAM/KMS setup.

Recent timeline (key interactions):
- 2024-09-12: Intro discovery call (owner Maya Chen). High-level ops requirements captured.
- 2024-10-03: Technical walkthrough w/ Diego (SE). Demo of dedicated pool + VPC setup.
- 2024-11-05: POC kickoff — 2-week latency/cost run. Fireflies meeting id ff_2024-11-05_a3f9b2.
- 2024-11-20: POC interim results: latency targets met (avg 120ms) but per-token cost ~15% above AWS estimate.
- 2025-01-08: Security review: Borealis security team asked for native AWS KMS, CloudTrail-forwarding, and consolidated IAM roles. See drive:/security/answers-borealis-scan.pdf.
- 2025-01-15: Procurement received a limited-time discount from AWS for Bedrock endpoints (10% over first year plus roadmap integration). Internal champion (CTO) left 2025-01-22; momentum dropped.
- 2025-02-10: Final procurement call — Borealis chooses AWS Bedrock managed endpoints; Redwood opportunity closed.

Use-case & requirements notes (from calls):
- Primary: omnichannel support-agent and doc-search for catalogs; secondary: embeddings for personalization and reranking for product search.
- Latency target: 100-200ms p95 for chat flows; throughput: 200 concurrent sessions peak.
- Data residency: US-only; VPC peering required.
- Security: SSO/SAML, audit logging, KMS-managed keys, evidence for SOC2 controls. CTO quote: "Native S3 + IAM integration is non-negotiable for us."

Why lost:
- Procurement offered a bundled deal on AWS managed endpoints (Bedrock + SageMaker) with existing credit lines and easier billing consolidation.
- Security team preferred single-vendor KMS/CloudTrail flow and lower perceived operational overhead for managed endpoints.
- Internal champion churn (CTO left) — no successor with bandwidth to continue evaluation.
- Budget window closed for Q1; team prioritized immediate integration speed over long-term performance/cost tradeoffs.

Follow-up / recommended salvage actions (internal notes):
- Archive POC artifacts; keep contact with Product Security (Elena Park owning CSM follow-ups) for future renewal cycles.
- Flag for 2025-Q4 re-engagement: potential pickup if multi-cloud or vendor lock concerns arise.
- Save POC metrics and cost comparison deck in opportunity folder for future objections.

Stubs / references:
- Pricing/proposal: drive:/proposals/borealis-redwood-proposal-v3.pdf
- Security Q&A: drive:/security/answers-borealis-scan.pdf
- Jira: RED-7892 (POC infra question).

Short notes / rep chatter:
- "Liked runtime perf, lost on biz terms + AWS integration."
- "No champion to push next steps after CTO exit."
- AE play: keep on account watchlist for 2025-Q4 re-open.
